name: spr_pp_dither25
rule: a mask, not art: the drawn pixels are pure white so draw_sprite_tiled_ext tints them to exactly the role colour that asks for them (the quay storm asks for ink), and the other pixels are transparent. One pixel in four (even x, even y), spec 13's 25 percent dither, tiled from the frame origin: 256 / 16 and 240 / 16 are whole, so no partial cell lands at the frame edge.
